bagPolicy.summary: Each ticketed fan may bring one approved clear bag and/or one small clutch; all bags are screened. Medical supplies are allowed after inspection, and childcare items must be carried in an approved clear bag.
prohibited: Bags that do not meet the clear-bag rules
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: ADA parking for men’s basketball is in Lot 56 with service by the Bud Walton Express; women’s basketball ADA spaces are available in all lots first come, first served. Bus parking is at Baum-Walker Stadium, about one mile south, without a public shuttle.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: For basketball games, rideshare drop-off and pickup is in front of the Jones Student-Athlete Success Center on Meadow Street, for vehicles with Lyft or Uber signage. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

concessions.summary: Levy operates concession stands throughout the arena with classic and locally inspired food. Outside food and beverages are not permitted.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: State-issued ADA permits are required for designated accessible parking. Elevators serve the floor, ground, and concourse levels at the south and east entrances.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Once a guest leaves the arena, re-entry is not permitted at any gate.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: For Razorback games, you scan your own mobile ticket at entry, one ticket per person, so download or transfer tickets before you arrive. For help on game day, go to the South Box Office at Bud Walton; otherwise call the Razorback Ticket Center at 479-575-5151 during business hours.

gates.summary: Doors open 90 minutes before men’s basketball games and 60 minutes before women’s basketball games. Public entrances are on the north, west, and south sides; the east entrance serves men’s basketball students.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
